_comment: Octail's own egg (no upstream file; Pelican's and Pterodactyl's TeamSpeak eggs were read as a reference only). The official Linux x86_64 server from teamspeak.com, its SHA-256 checked against teamspeak.com's version list (versions/server.json), failures exit non-zero. The TeamSpeak licence is never accepted for the operator: TS3SERVER_LICENSE (read by ts3server itself) is required, empty by default and only takes accept, and the startup refuses to run without it. While the panel setting server_tools.auto_accept_eula is on, the panel sets it to accept (features.eula_variable). ServerQuery (raw, TCP) and file transfer (TCP) get ports of their own (port_vars); SSH query is off. The serveradmin password is set at every start when given. ts3server reads no console input; it stops on Ctrl+C. The start is the voice port's listening line, or the UDP port once bound.
name: TeamSpeak 3 Server
author: eggs@octail.net
description: TeamSpeak 3 voice server: low-latency voice chat with channels, permissions and file transfer. The operator must accept the TeamSpeak licence before the server starts.
startup: [ "${TS3SERVER_LICENSE}" = accept ] || { echo 'The TeamSpeak licence is not accepted: read LICENSE in the server folder, then set TeamSpeak License to accept on the Startup tab.'; exit 1; }; LD_LIBRARY_PATH=. exec ./ts3server default_voice_port={{SERVER_PORT}} voice_ip=0.0.0.0 query_port={{QUERY_PORT}} query_ip=0.0.0.0 query_protocols=raw filetransfer_port={{FILE_TRANSFER_PORT}} filetransfer_ip=0.0.0.0 $( [ -z "${SERVERADMIN_PASSWORD}" ] || printf 'serveradmin_password=%s' "${SERVERADMIN_PASSWORD}" )

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# TeamSpeak 3 server installation script (Octail): the official Linux build from teamspeak.com, its SHA-256 checked
# against teamspeak.com's own version list, failures exit non-zero. The licence is NOT accepted here: the server
# starts only once the operator sets TS3SERVER_LICENSE=accept on the Startup tab.
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
set -euo pipefail

VERSIONS=https://www.teamspeak.com/versions/server.json
VERSION="${TS3_VERSION:-latest}"

if [ "$(uname -m)" != "x86_64" ]; then
    echo "Installation failed: TeamSpeak 3 has no Linux server for $(uname -m), only for x86_64 (amd64)."
    exit 1
fi

if ! LIST=$(curl -fsSL "$VERSIONS"); then
    echo "Installation failed: the version list $VERSIONS couldn't be read."
    exit 1
fi
LATEST=$(echo "$LIST" | jq -r '.linux.x86_64.version // empty')
LATEST_SUM=$(echo "$LIST" | jq -r '.linux.x86_64.checksum // empty')
LATEST_URL=$(echo "$LIST" | jq -r '.linux.x86_64.mirrors["teamspeak.com"] // empty')
if [ -z "$LATEST" ] || [ -z "$LATEST_SUM" ] || [ -z "$LATEST_URL" ]; then
    echo "Installation failed: $VERSIONS lists no Linux x86_64 server."
    exit 1
fi

[ "$VERSION" = "latest" ] && VERSION="$LATEST"
if [ "$VERSION" = "$LATEST" ]; then
    URL="$LATEST_URL"
    SUM="$LATEST_SUM"
else
    ## teamspeak.com publishes the checksum of the newest version only
    URL="https://files.teamspeak-services.com/releases/server/${VERSION}/teamspeak3-server_linux_amd64-${VERSION}.tar.bz2"
    SUM=""
fi
case "$URL" in
    https://*) ;;
    *)
        echo "Installation failed: $URL isn't an HTTPS address."
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

echo "Installing the TeamSpeak 3 server ${VERSION} from ${URL}"
cd /mnt/server
TMP=$(mktemp -d)
if ! curl -fsSL -o "$TMP/ts3.tar.bz2" "$URL"; then
    rm -rf "$TMP"
    echo "Installation failed: TeamSpeak 3 server ${VERSION} couldn't be downloaded (check the version)."
    exit 1
fi
if [ -n "$SUM" ]; then
    if ! echo "${SUM}  $TMP/ts3.tar.bz2" | sha256sum -c --quiet -; then
        rm -rf "$TMP"
        echo "Installation failed: the download doesn't match the checksum teamspeak.com lists."
        exit 1
    fi
    echo "Checksum OK (SHA-256 from teamspeak.com)."
else
    echo "teamspeak.com lists a checksum for ${LATEST} only; ${VERSION} is not checked."
fi

## the program files only: the database (ts3server.sqlitedb), uploaded files/ and logs/ stay on a reinstall
tar -xjf "$TMP/ts3.tar.bz2" --strip-components=1 -C /mnt/server
rm -rf "$TMP"

if [ ! -x /mnt/server/ts3server ]; then
    echo "Installation failed: the TeamSpeak 3 server is missing after unpacking."
    exit 1
fi

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed: TeamSpeak 3 server ${VERSION}."
echo "Set TeamSpeak License to accept on the Startup tab once you have read and accepted the licence."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: TeamSpeak License
variables.description: The TeamSpeak server licence (the LICENSE file in the server folder, also on teamspeak.com). Type accept once you have read and accepted it; the server doesn't start until then.

variables.name: TeamSpeak Version
variables.description: latest (the newest server teamspeak.com lists, checksum checked) or a version such as 3.13.7 (older versions aren't checksum checked). Reinstall to switch.

variables.name: ServerQuery Port
variables.description: The ServerQuery (raw, TCP) port, given when the server is created.

variables.name: File Transfer Port
variables.description: The file transfer port (TCP), given when the server is created.

variables.name: Serveradmin Password
variables.description: Optional: the ServerQuery serveradmin password, set at every start (8-64 letters, digits and _ . @ # % + -). Empty = keep the one printed on the first start.
